title: Moving Source Formula
text: When the source moves relative to a stationary observer: Source approaching: f' = fv/(v - v_s) (frequency increases). Source receding: f' = fv/(v + v_s) (frequency decreases).

title: Why the Plus Sign?
text: When the source moves away, the wavefronts are stretched out (wavelength increases), so frequency decreases. The effective wavelength becomes wavelength' = (v + v_s)/f, leading to f' = fv/(v + v_s). For this problem: 340 + 30 = 370 m/s.
